title: Sylow subgroups exist and have index prime to the prime
statement: Let $Q$ be a finite group and $r$ a prime number. Then $Q$ has a subgroup $P$ which is an $r$-group (every element of $P$ has order a power of $r$; equivalently, $P$ being finite, $\#P$ is a power of $r$) and whose index $[Q:P]$ is not divisible by $r$ (an $r$-Sylow subgroup).
